look.en: The cake looks delicious, I want to eat it now.
look.zh: 这个蛋糕看上去很好吃，我现在就想吃。

cashier.en: The cashier smiled and gave me my change.
cashier.zh: 收银员微笑着找给我零钱。

cola.en: I bought a cold cola from the store.
cola.zh: 我从商店买了一瓶冰可乐。

dollar.en: The book costs only one dollar in the shop.
dollar.zh: 这本书在商店只要一美元。

cent.en: I found a ten cent coin on the street.
cent.zh: 我在街上找到一枚十美分硬币。

enjoy.en: We enjoy playing games together after school.
enjoy.zh: 放学后我们一起玩游戏很开心。

careful.en: Be careful when you cross the busy road.

Be careful!.en: Be careful! The hot soup might burn your tongue.
Be careful!.zh: 当心！热汤可能会烫到你的舌头。

later.en: I will finish my homework later this evening.
later.zh: 我今晚稍后会完成作业。

to go.en: We have two slices of pizza to go for dinner.
to go.zh: 我们还有两片披萨剩着当晚餐。

duck.en: A yellow duck is swimming in the small pond.
duck.zh: 一只黄色的小鸭子在小池塘里游泳。

pond.en: The fish in the pond are very colorful and pretty.
pond.zh: 池塘里的鱼颜色很鲜艳漂亮。

cloud.en: The white cloud looks like a rabbit in the sky.
cloud.zh: 那朵白云在天空中看起来像一只兔子。

dry.en: Please wipe the table dry with a cloth.

like.en: The little girl sings like a beautiful bird.
like.zh: 那个小女孩唱起歌来像一只美丽的鸟。

look like.en: It looks like we will have a picnic today.
look like.zh: 看来我们今天要去野餐了。

stay.en: We should stay healthy by eating well.
stay.zh: 我们应该通过吃得好来保持健康。

shine.en: The sun will shine brightly tomorrow morning.
shine.zh: 明天早上太阳会明亮地照耀。

cry.en: Don't cry, your mother will come back soon.
cry.zh: 别哭，你妈妈很快就回来了。

everyone.en: Everyone in our class likes playing football.
everyone.zh: 我们班每个人都喜欢踢足球。

fly away.en: The butterfly will fly away if you touch it.
fly away.zh: 如果你碰它，蝴蝶就会飞走。

just.en: Just wait for me, I will be ready in a minute.
just.zh: 就等我一下，我一分钟就好。

cow.en: The cow gives us fresh milk every morning.
cow.zh: 那头奶牛每天早上给我们新鲜的牛奶。

blow.en: The wind will blow the leaves off the trees.
blow.zh: 风会把树叶从树上吹落。

rabbit.en: I saw a white rabbit hop in the garden.
rabbit.zh: 我看见一只白兔在花园里跳。

balloon.en: My red balloon flew high into the sky.
balloon.zh: 我的红气球高高飞上了天空。

stairs.en: Please hold the railing when you go down the stairs.

mess.en: After the party, the room was a big mess.
mess.zh: 派对结束后，房间一片狼藉。

play.en: My sister can play the piano very well.

third.en: He finished third in the running race.
third.zh: 他在跑步比赛中得了第三名。

time.en: This is the first time I visit Beijing.

bark.en: The dog started to bark at the mailman.

loudly.en: The children laughed loudly at the funny show.
loudly.zh: 孩子们对着有趣的表演大声笑。

nothing.en: There is nothing in the empty box.

home.en: I will go home after school today.

got.en: She got a lovely gift from her grandma.
got.zh: 她从奶奶那里得到了一份可爱的礼物。

space.en: I want to travel to space when I grow up.
space.zh: 我长大后想去太空旅行。

interested.en: She is interested in reading books about stars.
interested.zh: 她对阅读关于星星的书感兴趣。

spaceship.en: The spaceship flew very fast into the sky.
spaceship.zh: 宇宙飞船飞快地飞入天空。

finish.en: We finish our homework before dinner every day.
finish.zh: 我们每天晚饭前完成作业。

decide.en: They decide to build a model rocket together.
decide.zh: 他们决定一起做一个模型火箭。

paper.en: He made a paper airplane and threw it high.
paper.zh: 他做了一个纸飞机并把它扔得很高。

brought.en: She brought her favorite book to school today.
brought.zh: 她今天把她最喜欢的书带到了学校。

bring back.en: Please bring back my pencil after you use it.
bring back.zh: 你用完后请把我的铅笔带回来。

model.en: My brother has a model of a spaceship in his room.
model.zh: 我哥哥房间里有一个宇宙飞船模型。

taikonaut.en: The taikonaut waved to everyone before the flight.
taikonaut.zh: 宇航员在飞行前向大家挥手。

first.en: She was the first student to finish the test.
first.zh: 她是第一个完成测试的学生。

national.en: We sing the national anthem every Monday morning.
national.zh: 我们每周一早上唱国歌。

seed.en: I planted a seed in the garden and watered it every day.
seed.zh: 我在花园里种了一颗种子，每天给它浇水。

spent.en: We spent the whole afternoon playing football in the park.
spent.zh: 我们花了整个下午在公园里踢足球。

about.en: There are about twenty students in our English club.
about.zh: 我们英语俱乐部大约有二十名学生。

ﬂew.en: A bird flew over our house and landed on the tree.
ﬂew.zh: 一只鸟飞过我们的房子，落在了树上。

October.en: My birthday is in October, and I will have a party.
October.zh: 我的生日在十月，我会举办一个派对。

video.en: We watched a funny video about cats in class today.
video.zh: 今天我们在课堂上看了关于猫的有趣视频。

proud.en: My mom is proud of me because I got good grades.
proud.zh: 我妈妈为我感到骄傲，因为我取得了好成绩。

someday.en: I hope to visit the Great Wall of China someday.
someday.zh: 我希望有朝一日能参观中国长城。

born.en: My little sister was born on a sunny morning in May.
born.zh: 我的小妹妹出生在五月一个晴朗的早晨。

as.en: He works as a teacher in our school and helps us learn.
as.zh: 他在我们学校当老师，帮助我们学习。

became.en: The caterpillar became a beautiful butterfly after two weeks.
became.zh: 毛毛虫两周后变成了一只美丽的蝴蝶。

letter.en: The first letter of the word 'apple' is 'a'.
letter.zh: 单词 'apple' 的第一个字母是 'a'。

spell.en: Can you spell your name for me, please?
spell.zh: 你能为我拼写你的名字吗？

herself.en: She taught herself how to ride a bike.
herself.zh: 她自学了如何骑自行车。

all over.en: We looked all over the house for my keys.
all over.zh: 我们找遍了整个房子找我的钥匙。

live.en: The old man lived to be one hundred years old.
live.zh: 那位老人活到了一百岁。

role model.en: My mother is my role model because she is kind.
role model.zh: 我的妈妈是我的榜样，因为她很善良。

cup.en: Please fill my cup with water from the tap.
cup.zh: 请用水龙头的水把我的杯子装满。

planned.en: We planned a picnic for this Saturday afternoon.
planned.zh: 我们计划了这个星期六下午去野餐。

baseball.en: My brother likes to play baseball after school.
baseball.zh: 我哥哥喜欢放学后打棒球。

more.en: I need more time to finish my homework.
more.zh: 我需要更多时间来写完作业。

smile.en: She gave me a big smile when she saw me.
smile.zh: 她看到我时给了我一个大大的微笑。

mistake.en: I made a mistake in the spelling test today.
mistake.zh: 我今天在拼写测试中犯了一个错误。

make mistakes.en: Don't worry, we all make mistakes sometimes.
make mistakes.zh: 别担心，我们有时都会犯错误。

with.en: I often practice speaking English with my friends after class.
with.zh: 我经常课后和朋友一起练习说英语。

said.en: My teacher said we should read more books every day.
said.zh: 我的老师说我们应该每天多读书。

raincoat.en: Don't forget to take your raincoat before going to school.
raincoat.zh: 去上学前别忘了带上你的雨衣。

wish.en: I wish you a happy birthday and lots of fun.
wish.zh: 我祝你生日快乐，玩得开心。

best wishes.en: Best wishes to you and your family for the new year.
best wishes.zh: 向你和你的家人致以新年的最美好祝愿。

primary.en: We will leave our primary school and go to middle school soon.
primary.zh: 我们很快就要离开小学，去上中学了。

primary school.en: I have studied in this primary school for six years.
primary school.zh: 我在这所小学学习了六年。

message.en: Please leave a message on the board if you have any questions.
message.zh: 如果有问题，请在留言板上留言。

keep.en: Keep your desk clean and tidy every day at school.
keep.zh: 在学校每天保持课桌干净整洁。

forever.en: I will remember my best friends forever after graduation.
forever.zh: 毕业后我会永远记住我最好的朋友。

joy.en: Reading storybooks brings me great joy every weekend.
joy.zh: 每个周末读故事书给我带来很大的乐趣。

future.en: I hope to become a doctor in the future to help people.
future.zh: 我希望将来成为一名医生帮助别人。

wonderful.en: We had a wonderful time at the park yesterday.
wonderful.zh: 我们昨天在公园度过了美好的时光。

happiness.en: Her smile showed her happiness when she got the gift.
happiness.zh: 她收到礼物时，笑容显示了她的幸福。

what.en: What a beautiful sunny day it is today!
what.zh: 今天多么美丽晴朗的一天啊！

middle.en: The middle of the cake has a strawberry inside.
middle.zh: 蛋糕中间有一颗草莓在里面。

middle school.en: I will learn new subjects in middle school next year.
middle school.zh: 明年我将在中学学习新科目。

speech.en: Tom gave a short speech at the school assembly.
speech.zh: 汤姆在学校集会上做了一次简短演讲。

classmate.en: My classmate helped me with my maths homework.
classmate.zh: 我的同班同学帮我做了数学作业。

leave.en: We will leave the classroom at four o'clock.
leave.zh: 我们将在四点离开教室。

September.en: School starts again in September after summer holiday.
September.zh: 暑假后学校在九月再次开学。

excited.en: The children were excited about the school trip.
excited.zh: 孩子们对学校旅行感到兴奋。

geography.en: In geography class we learned about different countries.
geography.zh: 在地理课上我们了解了不同的国家。

same.en: We wear the same uniform every school day.
same.zh: 我们每个上学日穿相同的校服。

at the same time.en: My sister and I shouted at the same time.
at the same time.zh: 我和姐姐同时喊了起来。

spoke.en: He spoke English to the visitor yesterday.
spoke.zh: 他昨天对来访者说了英语。

little.en: I have very little money in my pocket.
little.zh: 我口袋里只有很少的钱。

keep on.en: Keep on trying and you will succeed.

practise.en: We practise the piano every evening.
practise.zh: 我们每天晚上练习钢琴。

sometime.en: Let's go to the park sometime next week.
sometime.zh: 我们下周某个时候去公园吧。

each other.en: They give each other birthday presents.

chemistry.en: I like chemistry because it is interesting.
chemistry.zh: 我喜欢化学因为它很有趣。

physics.en: Physics helps us understand how things move.
physics.zh: 物理帮助我们理解物体如何运动。
